title: Ben Webster, a class by himself
summary: Webster was lovable and could make you cry on tenor.

blocks.x: Uh-huh. He was a handsome -- Can you think of any particular stories, anything interesting to tell about any of them saxophone players?
There's not too much -- You know, saxophone players, there's not too many stories you can tell about them like you can about brass men.
Oh, well, forget about Ben. Ben was a class all to himself.
But Ben was the most lovable guy.
Ben liked to go around, you know. He liked to swing with everybody, --
-- you know. And he, to me, he could play a tenor and make you cry.
He could make you cry. He could make cold chills run up and down your back, you know.
